executive_summary: CKA seq 3 walks through the newly released probable cause indictment against Tyler James Robinson, with Candace Owens flagging missing timestamps in the Tyler-to-Lance text chain, omitted pre-scout footage referenced by Governor Cox, and the absence of a disassembled rifle. The episode also covers the George Zinn 'decoy' arrest, child abuse image charge, and exclusive Lance Twiggs family allegations (kicked out junior year, Christmas vodka overdose, Easter drug episode, deep-web usage). Second half confronts Bill Ackman's 955-word tweet response to the Hamptons retreat allegations, plays Charlie Kirk's Megyn Kelly appearance from August 6, and discusses donor pressure and a building donor retraction in the 48 hours before Charlie's death.
